ui.habitat_title: Habitat — real NASA ISS cabin data (context only, not scored)
ui.habitat_intro: Real telemetry from the NASA OSDR Environmental Data App, mission RR-1 (2014). CO2 is shown as an hourly mean in mmHg (ppm converted at 760 mmHg total pressure) against the NASA-STD-3001 habitat requirement (average one-hour CO2 partial pressure of 3 mmHg or less). The converted values are an approximation, not a compliance statement.
ui.habitat_flag: Flagged ARTIFACT: CO2 stayed at exactly {ppm:,.0f} ppm ({mm:.1f} mmHg) for {hours:.0f} h in the raw 5-minute series. Origin unknown (sensor or data fill). It is never shown as normal.
ui.habitat_table_title: Same check on every mission with usable CO2 data
ui.habitat_table_note: {n} missions. A constant run of at least 1 h exists in {k} of them. Zero or capped sensor values are marked. Rodent-research facility sensors, location and calibration not documented: do not read these rows as crew exposure.
ui.habitat_credit: Data and visualizations are courtesy of the Environmental Data App (EDA), https://visualization.osdr.nasa.gov/eda/. Requirement: NASA OCHMO-TB-004 Rev B (NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 2 Rev C, V2 6004).
